description: Defines ASN.1 structures and classes for RRC NR UL-CCCH1 message handling, including sequence and choice types, with serialization methods.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request1_ies_s
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence for RRC Resume Request IEs, including resume ID, MAC, cause, and spare bits.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request1_s
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence encapsulating RRC Resume Request IEs.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_type_c
classes.description: Choice type representing UL-CCCH1 message types, including RRC resume request and spares.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_s
classes.description: ASN.1 sequence for UL-CCCH1 message containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of the choice (e.g., c1, msg_class_ext).

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to msg_class_ext.
